entries.note: The assessment of mediocrity is Zitron's; the quoted praise is Newton's. Mediocrity supplies no agreed performance standard.
The claim identifies those most likely to benefit, rather than asserting realized benefits.

entries.test: Published benchmark procedures and controlled training experiments could establish whether access to the answer key enables optimization for correct benchmark answers.
entries.note: This asserts a technical capability, not a speculative chance that a vendor cheated.

entries.test: Representative ChatGPT usage data compared with SimpleQA's discrete factual-question format would establish whether that format represents most usage.
entries.note: The surrounding text identifies the relevant contrast as discrete factual questions versus longer, more complex tasks.
Product outcomes are checkable separately. The full claim also assigns an unobservable reason for Roose's omission.
Cowardice is a moral assessment of the optimism criticized in the post.
The death-cult description and sweeping characterization of participants are polemical exaggeration.
The spending amount is independently checkable. What collectively imagined artificial intelligence looks like supplies no shared test for the full proposition.

entries.test: Financial disclosures and credible reporting available at publication would show whether the relevant companies had evidence of a financially viable route to ending cash burn.
entries.note: This concerns the evidence then available, rather than a firm prediction of perpetual losses.

entries.test: Reported revenues, costs, unit economics and financing requirements would establish whether the named companies had a financially feasible route to profitability at publication.
entries.note: The sarcastic claim that this is acceptable does not negate his underlying assertion about profitability.

entries.test: CoreWeave's capacity contracts and Core Scientific's project history and revenue disclosures would establish buildout dependence, capacity, prior AI facilities and cryptocurrency revenue share.
entries.note: The qualification about prior AI facilities limits that component to the apparent public track record.
Required spending and existing liquidity are separately checkable. The full proposition includes an expressly uncertain claim about future access to funding.
The proposition reports Zitron's explanatory belief and attributes a private intention to Microsoft. Capacity changes alone cannot settle either mental state.

entries.test: OpenAI's reported financial position and unit economics would show whether adequate SoftBank financing leaves a financially feasible route to profitability.
entries.note: The concessive clause says financing does not solve the asserted business-model problem; it does not specify a future deadline.

entries.test: OpenAI's 2025 financial results, cash balances, fundraising and CoreWeave payment obligations would establish the claimed loss and dependence on new financing.
entries.note: The 2025 deadline has passed. This extraction preserves the later passage's 'over $14 billion,' despite the earlier 'as much as' estimate.

entries.test: SoftBank debt offerings, lender disclosures and financing outcomes during changes in AI investor sentiment would show whether that sentiment determines its borrowing access.
entries.note: The causal prediction is firm but has no deadline.

entries.test: The companies' financial disclosures and publicly documented operating plans at publication would establish annual losses and any tangible evidence of a route to ending them.
entries.note: The assertion concerns existing losses and evidence, even allowing for the listed financing and expansion arrangements.

entries.test: The companies' financing, cash requirements and continued operations through March 24, 2026 would establish whether maintaining the arrangement required tens of billions of dollars in new funding.
entries.note: The one-year horizon has passed. Funds raised alone would not establish that the full amount was necessary.
Building the economy 'on top of NVIDIA' has no shared scope or dependence threshold. NVIDIA's customers and the capacity pullback are separately checkable.
This condemns an attitude toward the industry's prospects rather than specifying an empirical outcome.
